quantity.name: FR angles (onset SP1 / full flexion MFF / cessation SP2)
quantity.definition: flexion angle at the first silent position SP1 (EMG silence begins in flexion), at maximum forward flexion MFF, and at SP2 (activity resumes in extension); Angles from photographs (35 mm camera, 3 m, right side) with skin markers: Trunk angle (TA) = angle between the long axis of the thigh and the line D1 spinous process - hip-joint centre; Hip angle (HA) = angle between the pelvic plane (ASIS-PSIS line) and the thigh axis; Vertebral angle (VA) = angle between the pelvic plane and the line PSIS - D1 spinous process; all as flexion from erect (deg).

title: Gupta 2001: erector spinae silence angles, bending with the pelvis held against a wall
condition: forward bending with buttocks held against a wall (pelvic motion restricted), no load

source.sample: 25 healthy young subjects (15 M, 10 F), no back symptoms; weighted task: 11 of the males

protocol.summary: Same subjects and task as normal bending but with the buttocks against a wall.
how_to_simulate: Forward flexion with pelvic rotation restricted (hip flexion ~19 deg at MFF)
Output: vertebral/trunk angle at lumbar ES silence; SP2 absent (ES active from the start of extension)

subject_model.source: Gupta 2001 Table 1 (as printed: mean height 1.58 m, weight 52.0 kg)

protocol.notes: Surface EMG bilaterally over erector spinae at the L3 spinous-process level ~5 cm from the midline (also abdominals, hamstrings, hip extensors); silence = oscilloscope amplitude dropping abruptly to zero (visual, photograph triggered); no normalisation needed (on/off only). SP1 at 28% (hip) and 75% (vertebral) of maximum flexion (text p.493).

data.note: not observed: erector spinae active from the very beginning of extension

data.x: SP1 as % of maximum hip flexion
SP1 as % of maximum vertebral flexion

extraction.from: Gupta 2001 Table 3 (pelvis against wall) and text p.493
extraction.check_notes: Checked against page image. | verified 2026-11-12 independent check: OK (Table 3 p.494 against-wall SP1/MFF values and SDs; 28/75% from Discussion text)

pass_rule.rule: |model - mean| <= 1 SD (angles); for SEM-reported data use SD = SEM x sqrt(n)
